description.it: Crea un cheat sheet con i 10 comandi Minikube che usi più spesso.
description.en: Create a cheat sheet with the 10 Minikube commands you use most often.

hint.it: Includi: start, stop, delete, status, dashboard, ssh, service, addons, profile, logs.
hint.en: Include: start, stop, delete, status, dashboard, ssh, service, addons, profile, logs.

description.it: Esegui un ciclo completo: start -> deploy -> test -> scale -> stop.
description.en: Execute a complete cycle: start -> deploy -> test -> scale -> stop.

hint.it: Usa un deployment Nginx per semplicità.
hint.en: Use an Nginx deployment for simplicity.

description.it: Simula un problema e risolvilo con logs, describe, events.
description.en: Simulate a problem and solve it with logs, describe, events.

hint.it: Crea un pod con immagine inesistente e debugga 'ImagePullBackOff'.
hint.en: Create a pod with a non-existent image and debug 'ImagePullBackOff'.

description.it: Verifica tutta la configurazione di Minikube e documenta le tue preferenze.
description.en: Verify all Minikube configuration and document your preferences.

hint.it: 'minikube config view' mostra le impostazioni correnti.

description.it: Crea, gestisci ed elimina profili multipli in sequenza.
description.en: Create, manage, and delete multiple profiles in sequence.

hint.it: Crea profili 'test' e 'staging', verifica, poi elimina.
hint.en: Create 'test' and 'staging' profiles, verify, then delete.

description.it: Trova e ispeziona i log di Minikube per un problema recente.
description.en: Find and inspect Minikube logs for a recent issue.

hint.it: I log sono in ~/.minikube/logs/ per data.

description.it: Abilita metrics-server e monitora risorse per 5 minuti.
description.en: Enable metrics-server and monitor resources for 5 minutes.

hint.it: Usa 'watch kubectl top nodes' per monitoraggio live.
hint.en: Use 'watch kubectl top nodes' for live monitoring.

description.it: Esegui un reset completo e ricostruisci un cluster pulito.
description.en: Perform a complete reset and rebuild a clean cluster.

description.it: Crea uno script bash che automatizzi il setup completo del tuo cluster.
description.en: Create a bash script that automates your complete cluster setup.

hint.it: Includi: start, addons enable, profile setup, deploy base.
hint.en: Include: start, addons enable, profile setup, deploy base.

description.it: Rispondi a queste domande senza consultare la documentazione.
description.en: Answer these questions without consulting documentation.

hint.it: Quali comandi usi per: status, logs, ssh, addons, profile?
hint.en: What commands do you use for: status, logs, ssh, addons, profile?
